result.summary: This is a safety emergency that I've escalated to the duty team as high priority (queue 25). Water is still coming through a wet ceiling light fitting in Flat 2, and the ceiling bulge there is reported to be getting larger. The suspected source flat, Flat 3, can't be accessed: the tenant refuses entry, the landlord hasn't authorised it, and the duty manager found no agency authority to enter. That decision belongs to the agency director, or to the emergency services if there is immediate danger. I sent the Flat 3 tenant the plumber's details and proposed work in writing, as she asked. I also updated the landlord, recorded who can authorise access, and set a 6-hour hold.
result.situation: Flat 2 has active water ingress through a bedroom ceiling light fitting, with a growing bulge. The electrician (Vellum Electrical) is due 12:30–13:15. The plumber (Brindle Flow Plumbing) and building manager Selka Venn checked Flat 2 and the common riser and found no source or isolation valve. Flat 3 tenant Yara refuses entry until about 17:30. Landlord Niko does not authorise entry, and duty manager Devra found no delegated entry authority.

judgement.why_this_decision: Under the emergency rules, an escape of water at an electrical fitting with a growing ceiling bulge (events 17, 23) needs a high-priority escalation. Entry is blocked: Yara refused (events 9, 20), Niko declined to authorise it (events 11, 19), and Devra found no delegated authority and named the director as the route (event 22). I sent Yara the written details she asked for because that is the most likely way to get consent.
